correctness.rationale: All 6^6 three-pair strict profiles and 3! candidate matchings per profile are examined with exact blocking-pair checks; all one- and two-pair profiles are also covered. Thus the finite theorem is exhaustive, with no unsupported infinite extension.

value.rationale: This is a natural price-of-fairness invariant comparing Nash product and sex-equal stability in the same rank-utility model. The smallest market capable of a positive cost is identified, the sharp loss is 9/4, all attainable finite-market ratios and their frequencies are classified, and the two extremal symmetry orbits are explicit. These precise quantities are not implied merely by correctness or prior set-disagreement counts and form a reusable theoretical benchmark.
